title: Generate BEV C05 Knowledge Sheets for Supervisory and Safety Management
description: Create complete KP (Knowledge Sheets) and KT (Assignment Sheets) for BEV C05 Supervisory and Safety Management competency unit. Extract 12-15 Related Knowledge items from NOSS C05 CoCU and develop 4 knowledge sheets covering: (1) Team Briefing and Safety Culture, (2) SHE Monitoring and Hazard Management, (3) Training Supervision and Competency Verification, (4) Performance Documentation and Compliance. Each KP includes related knowledge statements, learning outcomes, and bilingual terminology. Each KT provides 5-8 questions (MCQ, short answer, scenario-based) with answer schemes.
acceptanceCriteria: All 12-15 NOSS C05 Related Knowledge items extracted and mapped to KP sheets (coverage verified in bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05/coverage-index.md)

4 KP files created following JPK format with terminology tables, learning outcomes, and technical depth: KP-01-team-briefing.md, KP-02-she-monitoring.md, KP-03-training-supervision.md, KP-04-documentation.md
4 corresponding KT assignment files with varied question types, answer schemes, and rubric scales (0-10 points per question)
technicalNotes: File to read: bev-diagnostic-rectification/00-noss-extract.md (locate C05 Related Knowledge section)
Files to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05/KP-01.md through KP-04.md (~400 words each), KT-01.md through KT-04.md (~500 words each)
Test command: uv run python _agents/validate-format.py --subject bev --cu C05 --check-coverage
Validation: Confirm all EN/BM terminology pairs match master glossary via terminology-validator.py

title: Build Cross-Subject Bilingual Terminology Validator and Master Glossary Database
description: Create Python validator script and master glossary database to ensure EN/BM bilingual terminology consistency across all WIM subjects (BEV, Aesthetic, IT). Script scans all KP files, extracts terminology tables, validates against master glossary, identifies duplicates and conflicts, and generates audit report with auto-correction suggestions. Master glossary consolidates 80+ approved government-standard BM terms (MySPIKE source) and industry-specific EN equivalents organized by domain with conflict resolution rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script (_agents/terminology-validator.py) reads all KP files across 3 subjects, extracts EN/BM pairs, outputs CSV report with columns [Term, Expected_EN, Expected_BM, Found_Variants, Consistency_Status, Suggested_Fix]

Master glossary (_reference/master-glossary.md) contains 80+ EN/BM pairs organized by domain (electrical, mechanical, health&safety, business management), includes MySPIKE references and conflict resolution notes
Validator identifies 3 classes of issues: (1) Missing BM translations, (2) Inconsistent BM spelling across subjects, (3) Deprecated terms; generates actionable repair suggestions
technicalNotes: File to create: _agents/terminology-validator.py (~160 lines) - regex parser for KP markdown tables, glossary lookup, report generator
File to create: _reference/master-glossary.md (~300 lines) - embedded CSV with term metadata, source attribution, approval status
Test command: uv run python _agents/terminology-validator.py --subjects bev,aesthetic,it --output reports/terminology-audit-2026-04-16.csv
Integration: Script callable from .spiral/ test framework for automated consistency checks on each commit
